name: Push-Up
coaching_cues: Brace ribs down|Hands under shoulders|Move as one plank
safety_notes: Avoid sagging hips|Stop for shoulder pain
card_text_long: Keep a strong plank and complete smooth push-ups.

name: Air Squat
coaching_cues: Knees track toes|Chest tall|Full foot pressure
safety_notes: Avoid painful depth|Control each rep
card_text_long: Sit between the hips and stand tall with control.

name: Reverse Lunge
coaching_cues: Step back softly|Front knee tracks toes|Drive through front foot
safety_notes: Use support if balance is limited|Avoid knee collapse
card_text_long: Alternate controlled reverse lunges on each side.

name: Glute Bridge
coaching_cues: Press through heels|Ribs down|Squeeze glutes at top
safety_notes: Avoid over-arching low back
card_text_long: Lift hips by squeezing glutes without arching the back.

name: Dead Bug
coaching_cues: Low back gently anchored|Move slow|Exhale as limb extends
safety_notes: Reduce range if back arches
card_text_long: Move opposite arm and leg while keeping the trunk quiet.

name: Side Plank
coaching_cues: Stack shoulders|Lift hips|Breathe steadily
safety_notes: Stop for shoulder pain|Keep neck relaxed
card_text_long: Hold a straight side plank with steady breathing.

name: Bear Crawl
coaching_cues: Opposite hand and foot|Hips low|Quiet steps
safety_notes: Keep wrists comfortable|Move slowly first
card_text_long: Crawl with hips low and controlled opposite-limb steps.

name: Mountain Climbers
coaching_cues: Hands planted|Drive knees under hips|Keep shoulders stacked
safety_notes: Use slower pace for control|Stop if wrists hurt
card_text_long: Drive knees from a strong plank at a sustainable pace.

name: Band Row
coaching_cues: Squeeze shoulder blades|Elbows close|Tall posture
safety_notes: Anchor band securely|Avoid shrugging
card_text_long: Row the band toward the ribs with tall posture.

name: Band Pallof Press
coaching_cues: Ribs down|Resist rotation|Press straight out
safety_notes: Anchor band securely|Keep knees soft
card_text_long: Press the band forward while resisting rotation.

name: Band Pull Apart
coaching_cues: Arms long|Pull to chest height|Shoulders down
safety_notes: Use light tension|Avoid neck tension
card_text_long: Pull the band apart under control at chest height.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
coaching_cues: Hold weight close|Knees track toes|Brace before descent
safety_notes: Choose load you can control|Avoid painful depth
card_text_long: Squat with the dumbbell held close at the chest.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
coaching_cues: Push hips back|Soft knees|Keep weights close
safety_notes: Maintain neutral spine|Stop if back pain appears
card_text_long: Hinge at the hips with dumbbells close to the legs.

name: Dumbbell Row
coaching_cues: Pull elbow to hip|Keep shoulders square|Control the lower
safety_notes: Support torso as needed|Avoid twisting
card_text_long: Row the dumbbell toward the hip with a stable torso.

name: Dumbbell Farmer Carry
coaching_cues: Tall posture|Crush the handles|Walk under control
safety_notes: Keep path clear|Set weights down safely
card_text_long: Carry dumbbells with tall posture and controlled steps.

name: Kettlebell Swing
coaching_cues: Explosive hip snap|Arms relaxed|Bell floats from hips
safety_notes: Learn hinge first|Do not squat the swing
card_text_long: Hinge and snap the hips to swing the bell to chest height.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
coaching_cues: Hips back|Chest proud|Stand tall with glutes
safety_notes: Keep bell close|Avoid rounding back
card_text_long: Deadlift the kettlebell by hinging and standing tall.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
coaching_cues: Hug bell close|Elbows inside knees|Full foot pressure
safety_notes: Control depth|Keep torso braced
card_text_long: Squat with a kettlebell held close to the chest.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
coaching_cues: Lats tight|Bar skims legs|Hips travel back
safety_notes: Use conservative load|Stop if back rounds
card_text_long: Hinge with the bar close and return to a tall stand.

name: Bench Step-Up
coaching_cues: Whole foot on bench|Drive through top leg|Stand tall
safety_notes: Use stable surface|Step down with control
card_text_long: Step onto a stable bench and control the descent.
